question: 总消耗
sql: SELECT SUM(spend) AS spend FROM daily_metrics WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-23' AND DATE '2026-08-29'

question: 渠道消耗
sql: SELECT c.channel_name, SUM(m.spend) AS spend FROM daily_metrics m JOIN channels c ON m.channel_id = c.channel_id WHERE m.date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-23' AND DATE '2026-08-29' GROUP BY c.channel_name

question: Campaign 消耗 Top 3
sql: SELECT campaign_id, SUM(spend) AS spend FROM daily_metrics WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-23' AND DATE '2026-08-29' GROUP BY campaign_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 3

question: 每日 CTR 趋势
sql: SELECT date, SUM(clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions),0) AS ctr FROM daily_metrics WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-23' AND DATE '2026-08-29' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

question: 本期上期消耗
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN date >= DATE '2026-08-23' THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period, SUM(spend) AS spend FROM daily_metrics WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-16' AND DATE '2026-08-29' GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
